channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: Indian sprinter Dhanalakshmi Sekar handed eight-year ban for second doping offence
item.description: National Anti-Doping Agency sanctions former national record-holder after second positive test for anabolic steroid.

item.title: I was told to stop playing Football and get married | By Kaviya Pakkirisamy
item.description: Indian women footballer Kaviya Pakkirisamy opens up about fighting early marriage pressure, stitching torn boots to keep playing, and overcoming an ACL injury.

item.title: Malaysian Open: Ayush Shetty stuns Olympic medalist Lee Zii Jia in first round
item.description: Meanwhile, Lakshya defeated Jason Teh Jia Heng of Singapore in his first round match.

item.title: Former IOA President Suresh Kalmadi passes away
item.description: Suresh Kalmadi, a former Union Minister was at the centre of the 2010 CWG scandal.

item.title: Indian Super League to kick off on February 14 as long-running uncertainty ends
item.description: Union Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya confirmed the ISL start date after crucial talks between clubs, AIFF and the sports ministry.

item.title: East Bengal run riot on Anthony Andrews’ 50th IWL match as league action continues
item.description: Fazila Ikwaput starred in a dominant East Bengal win, while Sesa earned their first point and Sethu staged a comeback on a busy IWL matchday.

item.title: Shrachi Bengal Tigers Edge SG Pipers in Shootout to Seal Women’s HIL Final Spot
item.description: Bengal Tigers secured a bonus point through sudden-death drama after a goalless draw to book a final rematch against SG Pipers.

item.title: Squash: Anahat Singh clinches U19 girls' silver at British Junior Open
item.description: Anahat Singh went down 9-11, 11-7, 3-11, 9-11 in the final to France's Lauren Baltayan.

item.title: Men's HIL: Tamil Nadu Dragons beat Soorma Hockey Club; climb to top of table
item.description: Selvaraj Kanagaraj (28’), Uttam Singh (30’) and Blake Govers scored in Tamil Nadu Dragons' win.

item.title: Malaysia Open: PV Sindhu advances to second round; Dhruv-Tanisha exit
item.description: Sindhu defeated lower-ranked Sung Shuo-Yun of Chinese Taipei in straight games to begin her year on a good note.
